title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: GitHub Copilot Agent Tools now available in the AL Extension (New AL Tools Available for Agents)
summary: Microsoft released GitHub Copilot agent tools for the AL VSIX extension that enable agents to automate and orchestrate AL workflows. These experimental tools including al_build, al_download_symbols, and al_publish are available in Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (version 17.0) and require VS Code 1.99 with agent mode enabled.
key_points: New GitHub Copilot agent tools added to AL VSIX for automating AL development workflows
Tools include al_build, al_download_symbols, and al_publish commands accessible to agents
Available in Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (version 17.0) and works with runtime 16.0
Requires VS Code 1.99 or later with agent mode enabled via chat.agent.enabled setting
Tools are experimental and subject to change in future updates

quotes.text: These tools enable the GitHub Copilot agent mode to automate and orchestrate AL workflows, making development faster, smarter, and more flexible.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit and purpose of the new agent tools for AL developers

quotes.text: Agent mode is available starting from VS Code 1.99.
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the minimum VS Code version requirement for using these tools

quotes.text: These tools are experimental and subject to change in future updates.
